contests.title: 2a. AGRUPACION PROVINCIAL ATACAMA-COQUIMBO
contests.notes: Figures are the T (total) column of the grouping-total column on the last commune page (V/M split ignored). Lists are the two federated tickets as printed (A.- CONFEDERACION DE LA DEMOCRACIA = CODE: PDC, PN, PADENA, PIR, DR; B.- PARTIDO DE LA UNIDAD POPULAR = Unidad Popular: PS, PC, PR, MAPU, IC, API). The volume prints no per-party vote totals, only federation totals and candidate preferences, so each list is a federation, not a party. List row 'A.-'/'B.-' figure = votes for the federation without preference (unassigned). Candidate parties (P.D.C., P.N., P.C., P.S., P.R.) are hand-annotated beside elected names in the Tribunal Calificador proclamation (p101-102); non-elected candidates' parties are not printed (null). Seats elected per federation from the proclamation, consistent with p3 (CODE-UP elected counts). valid not printed (lists sum to cast minus nulos and blancos). Totals agree with the Tribunal's Escrutinio General summary on p80. Registered voters not printed.

notes: 1973 ordinary Senate election, even-numbered agrupaciones (2a, 4a, 6a, 8a, 10a), 5 seats each. Pages 5-78 give commune/department/province/grouping tables with V/M/T columns; grouping totals transcribed from pp 17, 35, 49, 65, 78 (T column). Parties ran in two federations: CODE (Confederación de la Democracia) and UP (Unidad Popular, printed 'Partido (de la) Unidad Popular'); the tables print only federation totals, so lists = federations and per-party totals cannot be recorded. p2 lists candidates per federation; p3 counts candidates and elected per federation; p80 is the Tribunal Calificador's Escrutinio General by agrupación (national totals taken from its TOTAL AGRUPACIONES row; nulos y blancos combined there); pp 81-100 repeat it by department (not transcribed, totals match); pp 101-102 Sentencia de Proclamación with hand-written party abbreviations. Registered voters never printed.
